editorial.blurb: Esquina del Sazón serves authentic Mexican comfort food in a warm, welcoming space where friendly service and homemade flavors shine—especially their celebrated beef soup.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early for the best experience; ask your server to recommend their house-made aguas frescas like horchata de coco, piña, and maracuyá, which pair beautifully with any dish.

topDishes.note: tender chunks of beef in rich, deeply seasoned broth with potatoes and carrots—reviewers call it the best they've ever had
